description: One slot for one collaborator: four channels of CV go out to them and four come back, with a Resonance Hub in the same unbroken row

params.text: Takes the four outgoing channels from the CV Peer to its left for any of this one's IN jacks with no cable in them; clicking it sets every CV Peer to the right the same way, and it comes up on

inputs.text: CV sent to the collaborator in this slot on that channel; a signal arriving by normalling is used on this machine only, and nothing is sent over the network unless a cable is patched here

outputs.text: The CV the collaborator in this slot is sending on that channel, ramped to each newly received value across a 240th of a second in place of stepping to it
5V while the collaborator in this slot is sending on any of the four channels, and 0V otherwise

notes: the panel carries the collaborator's name, their round-trip time, the device they are using, a lamp per channel, and LOCAL or LAN when they are on the same machine or the same network
a slot reading Waiting... has nobody in it yet; people are put into open slots as they join the room
a slot keeps its person when they drop out, so the same collaborator comes back to the same module and the patch does not have to be rewired
